aggregates_sql.routes: SELECT count(*) AS records,sum(name IS NULL) AS name_null,sum(name IS NOT NULL AND trim(name)='') AS name_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(from_name IS NULL) AS from_null,sum(from_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(from_name)='') AS from_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(to_name IS NULL) AS to_null,sum(to_name IS NOT NULL AND trim(to_name)='') AS to_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(ref_raw IS NULL) AS ref_null,sum(line_id IS NULL) AS line_id_null,sum(headway_min IS NOT NULL) AS headway_nonnull,sum(timing_quality<>'unknown') AS timing_quality_not_unknown FROM routes
aggregates_sql.stops_all: SELECT count(*) AS records,sum(name IS NULL) AS name_null,sum(name IS NOT NULL AND trim(name)='') AS name_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(lat IS NULL) AS lat_null,sum(lon IS NULL) AS lon_null,sum(lat IS NULL OR lon IS NULL) AS either_coordinate_null,sum(ref_raw IS NULL) AS ref_null FROM stops
aggregates_sql.stops_linked_unique: SELECT count(*) AS records,sum(name IS NULL) AS name_null,sum(name IS NOT NULL AND trim(name)='') AS name_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(lat IS NULL OR lon IS NULL) AS either_coordinate_null FROM stops WHERE id IN (SELECT stop_id FROM route_stops)
aggregates_sql.stop_occurrences: SELECT count(*) AS records,sum(s.name IS NULL) AS name_null,sum(s.name IS NOT NULL AND trim(s.name)='') AS name_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(s.lat IS NULL OR s.lon IS NULL) AS either_coordinate_null FROM route_stops q JOIN stops s ON s.id=q.stop_id
aggregates_sql.platforms_all: SELECT count(*) AS records,sum(name IS NULL) AS name_null,sum(name IS NOT NULL AND trim(name)='') AS name_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(geometry_json IS NULL OR geometry_json='null') AS geometry_null FROM platforms
aggregates_sql.platforms_linked_unique: SELECT count(*) AS records,sum(name IS NULL) AS name_null,sum(name IS NOT NULL AND trim(name)='') AS name_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(geometry_json IS NULL OR geometry_json='null') AS geometry_null FROM platforms WHERE id IN (SELECT platform_id FROM route_platforms)
aggregates_sql.platform_occurrences: SELECT count(*) AS records,sum(p.name IS NULL) AS name_null,sum(p.name IS NOT NULL AND trim(p.name)='') AS name_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(p.geometry_json IS NULL OR p.geometry_json='null') AS geometry_null FROM route_platforms q JOIN platforms p ON p.id=q.platform_id
aggregates_sql.facilities_all: SELECT count(*) AS records,sum(name IS NULL) AS name_null,sum(name IS NOT NULL AND trim(name)='') AS name_empty_or_ascii_whitespace,sum(geometry_json IS NULL OR geometry_json='null') AS geometry_null FROM facilities
aggregates_sql.route_ref_collisions: SELECT count(*) AS collision_lookup_tokens FROM (SELECT ref_lookup FROM stop_refs GROUP BY ref_lookup HAVING count(DISTINCT stop_id)>1)
